summary: This figure summarizes the geo-distributed cloud deployment used to evaluate Chop Chop. The default benchmark setup involves 64 AWS c6i.8xlarge servers (32 vCPUs each) spread across 14 regions grouped into six continents (North America, South America, Europe, South Africa, Australia, Asia). Within each region, 18 load-client and 6 broker instances generate and relay load; 16 additional AWS clients interact directly with brokers, and the servers also connect to 64 load-broker instances hosted on a second cloud provider, OVH, to test cross-cloud broker behavior. The diagram is a nested containment diagram: an orange dashed AWS box contains a gray dashed continent box, which contains a green dashed region box holding Load clients and Brokers; Clients, Servers and the OVH Load brokers sit as separate boxes connected by arrows, with cloud icons marking the two providers.
